messages:
maria: spotted a sharp uptick in fncall schema rejects in canary-usw starting ~10:12 UTC, customers hitting errors. :frowning:
ajay: any sample error lines? strict or parse?
maria: strict-validate rejects. e.g. validator=v2 reason=TYPE_MISMATCH field=metadata.timestamp expected=string got=number
ajay: that suggests model started returning ints for timestamps in some batching path. we also saw ~35% reroute to degen/text which bloats token spend.
sam: important Q: which route gets billed when rerouted? we need correct quota attribution.
ajay: today billing attaches to final_route (degen). origin route shows dropped requests, so reject counts are misleading.
dev-console: short-term UI idea: add columns origin_route and final_route and a filter for validation.reason_id so ops can see misattribution. need stable field names.
maria: short-term mitigation: flip canary validator to soft-mode (allow passthrough + tag) until we patch coercion rules. prefer this to blocking clients.
ajay: ok. if we soft-mode, emit fncall.validation.soft_fail=true and add fncall.cost.attributed.origin to let billing reconcile. also increase DLQ sample rate for this slice so we can inspect payloads.
dev-console: I can add a rollout toggle "soft-validate on reject" and wire a temporary badge. will also add an alert: (reject_rate >= 0.5% AND fallback_rate >= 10%) => page.
maria: thanks. ajay please own the toggle and telemetry fields. sam will monitor billing impact.
ajay: will push toggle + metrics by 10:30 and open a short RFC for reason enum and migration plan.
